propositions: Effective review criteria and routing are read through multiple code paths, allowing project disables to be ignored, project DET criteria to disappear, and separate reads to describe inconsistent repository policy states

CriteriaSnapshot must compile one immutable, digest-bound authority containing effective built-in criteria, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, metadata, and source provenance before any selection or model invocation

Code review project LLM criteria must declare applies_to as a non-empty list of non-empty repository-relative globs, with ["**"] as the canonical spelling for repository-wide unconditional selection that replaces the prior applies_to: [] behavior

The shared _validate_applies_to validator must remain unchanged to preserve plan-review project criteria contract (empty list permitted), while the stricter non-empty-glob rule applies only to code_review project criteria at snapshot compile time
CriteriaSnapshot reuses the existing _overlay_signature content digest rather than introducing a parallel digest mechanism, and consumers receive the snapshot without re-reading ambient policy
